holder-quote: Her teeth were sharp and only the [Eater] was moving.

It was a strange thing. The other Hob was female. And she had a larger head than normal. Her teeth weren’t regular enamel, but some fusion with steel or something harder. She was shorter than a regular Hob, and her class was [Eater], along with [Rider]. She was better than Eater Goats at biting through things, and she often did in combat.

Food was a lifestyle for Snapjaw. She could convert it to muscle or fat amazingly quickly and she had a metabolism that meant she could gobble food or go for long periods without. Badarrow prodded his stomach. He followed Snapjaw deeper into the fortress.

holder-quote: She felt so much that she was going to start crying. Again. And she hadn’t stopped for two hours last night. To stave that off, because she didn’t want to distress anyone, Erin looked at Snapjaw. She’d happy-cry later. Or sad-cry, as the case might be.
“Yes. I was a [Biter]. Now, [Eater]. I eat, I get strong.”
Snapjaw breathed. She looked around. Numbtongue stared at her. She shoved him.
Snapjaw stared at Olesm. She had come back, panting, and her Frost Wyvern was lying on the ground. She’d found no tracks. But there was a scent-trail.
Snapjaw poked him in the side. He grunted.
Adetr stared as Mrsha came back with Gire. Rose looked at the hamburger from the Silverfang stalls with fries.
Snapjaw was so sad that the frosting bag was empty she nearly cried
Rags glanced at Snapjaw, and the [Eater] tapped one wrist significantly

Snapjaw is an [Eater], but also a [Chieftain] and a [Warrior].
